scope: One run of every legal row of the model dpi_openarray_shape after its expectation for svIncrement was corrected, outside the selected witnesses. The rows are not fixed-suite tests and do not enter any count. Rows are compiled from the generator with the C helper tests/ch35/cross_dpi_array.c.

revision.reason: IEEE 1800-2023 20.7 gives $increment -1 for every queue or dynamic array dimension, and H.12.2 gives svIncrement the same semantics. The model applied the fixed-size rule (1 when left >= right) to a dynamic array or queue of one element.
revision.version_note: The version stays 1: the legal rows, the selection and the designs do not change, and only the expected text of rows with a one-element dynamic array or queue changes.

kirimasim.note: Every row is unsupported because the runner does not load C code; no row was executed.

icarus.note: Icarus Verilog 13.0 has no DPI and rejects every row at compilation.

verilator.note: All 72 rows with a fixed-size actual match. The 96 rows with a dynamic array or queue actual end in an internal error at build, as before. The 32 rows whose expectation changed are among them, so no simulator of the three executes a changed row.
